_comment: DEVELOPMENT OVERRIDES. Every flag here is OFF in a shipping build. The server logs a loud banner at boot whenever any of them is on, and Economy specs assert that turning them off restores normal behaviour -- so a flag left on cannot hide.
_shipChecklist: Before publishing: set enabled=false. tools/ship-check verifies it and fails the build if it is still true.

infiniteCurrency._note: Purchases still run the full server-side transaction -- ownership, category and price checks all apply. The balance simply never drops. That way the shop code being exercised in dev is the same code that ships; only the wallet is fake.

unlockEverything._note: Ignores the map-clear gates in economy.json unlocks. Lets Woods be opened without grinding Speedball first.

skipRounds._note: Jump straight to a later round of the five-round match when tuning the hard end.

forceTier._note: Pins every round to one bot tier, overriding the round schedule's escalation.

verboseBots._note: Turns the LiveRound.Bots logger up to verbose on a live server. Noisy: six bots' state transitions every tick.
